verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is an online state filing and records service, so issuing API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents only browser-based e-filing, payment options and status lookups. Nothing mentions an API, API keys, tokens, or scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents. The prepaid Sunbiz E-File Account is a payment mechanism, not a credential system, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
